content: this is a summary of a civil case that took place in the vilnius city district court the court made a final resolution regarding the division of matrimonial property the applicant was awarded items such as a car smartwatch phone computer fish tanks and other household items the defendant was awarded items such as wardrobes a grass trimmer a double bed kitchen appliances and other household items the court determined that the applicant is entitled to receive €3570 and the defendant is entitled to receive €800 however due to the unequal value of the assets the defendant has been ordered to pay the applicant €985 as compensation the court also declared that the applicant is responsible for a personal obligation related to a credit card agreement the court has established that the child resides with the applicant and ordered the defendant to pay child maintenance the defendant is also required to pay arrears for child maintenance the court has ordered the defendant to pay the minimum amount of maintenance which is half the minimum wage the court has ordered the applicant to pay child maintenance and the defendant to pay the applicants legal costs the court has also recognized the applicants personal liability for a credit card agreement the court has divided the joint property of the couple and awarded specific items to each party the court has ordered the party in whose favor the judgment was given to pay the costs incurred by the other party the court has dismissed certain parts of the application and counterclaim

metadata.cost: - € 1 067,00 (professional fees) + € 240,00 (stamp duty )to be borne by the applicant; € 49,87 (stamp duty) to be borne by the defendant
